title: Jungle Expedition

reviewPolicy.reason: Player visual judgment remains authoritative. Pass 12 adds a lived-in procedural resident community and deterministic work-loop evidence while preserving every Pass 11 environment, weather, construction, tunnel, wildlife, and Emerald Zenith system.

viteProductionBuild.notes: Existing mixed static/dynamic import and large chunk warnings remain; the production bundle completed successfully.

implementedVisualSystems: four respectful everyday resident identities make the Lost City feel inhabited: river gatherers, temple conservators, expedition cartographers, and canopy gardeners

each profession has a distinct stature, skin palette, clothing palette, headwear, working pose, and tool silhouette including water vessels, conservation brushes, map boards, pruning poles, and carrying baskets
four primary workers occupy separate open riverbank and promenade stations while two additional High-quality residents work deeper in the settlement
role-specific procedural work rhythms animate gathering, stone tending, map study, and canopy tending through the existing basin material, adding no new draw call
deterministic work-a and work-b preview beats expose opposite animation phases while reduced-motion mode settles every resident into a readable authored pose
all four professions remain present on Low quality; Medium and High add residents without changing the community's role identity
resident geometry is presentation-only, stays outside the protected board route and landmark tunnels, and performs no gameplay writes
the grounded river, multilayer jungle, exotic wildlife, weather cycle, five landmark stories, build choreography, route tunnels, Living Compass, and Emerald Zenith finale from Pass 11 remain intact

evidence.proves: the normal narrow-phone overview now reads as a lived-in settlement, with distinct workers distributed across the promenade without crowding the board route
the red temple conservator works with a long brush beside the turquoise river gatherer, whose broad hat, carrying basket, and water vessel read at close mobile scale
the same left-bank camera at the opposite deterministic work phase, preserving the authored poses while the resident work shader advances
the ochre canopy gardener and pruning pole remain distinct from the blue cartographer and pale map board on the right riverbank
